senses.gloss: मल- + आवह मल- + आवह, adj. 1. soiling. 2. defiling.
मल्ल- + भू मल्ल- + भू, f. an arena for athletic contests.
मल्ल- + भूमि मल्ल- + भूमि, f. an arena for athletic contests.
† मल् मल्, मल्ल् मल्ल्, i. 1, Ātm., and भल मल्, 1. 10, मलय, or मलापय, Par. To hold.
मल्ल् मल्ल्, see मल्.

मल मल,
 I. adj.
 1. Dirty.
 2. Niggardly.
 II. (m. and) n.
 1. Dirt, filth, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 9.
 2. Sediment, dregs.
 3. Filthy refuse, Man. 11, 93.
 4. Excretion of the body, as fæces, etc., Man. 5, 132.
 5. Sin, Man. 2, 102.
 6. Defilement, Man. 11, 70.
 7. Rust.
 8. Camphor.
 9. Cuttle fishbone.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μέλας (cf. मलिन), μόρον, μάρμαρος, μαρμάιρω; A.S. smere, smerian, smerwian, smyrian.

मल्ल मल्ल,
 I. adj.
 1. Strong.
 2. Excellent.
 II. m.
 1. A wrestler; the son of an outcaste Kṣatriya, Man. 10, 22; 12, 45.
 2. A cup.
 3. The hemicranium.
 4. The residue of an oblation.
 III. f. ला.
 1. A woman.
 2. Arabian jasmine.
 --Comp.

माल माल,
 I. m.
 1. A name of a barbarous tribe, Lass. 38, 14.
 2. The name of a country, Megh. 16.
 3. Viṣṇu.
 II. i. e. मल + अ, f. ला.
 1. A line.
 2. A garland, a necklace, Hit. i. d. 174, M.M. (धृत-कनक-माल, adj. Bearing a gold necklace).
 3. A chaplet of flowers.
 4. A rosary.
 5. A chain, Pañc. 255, 19.
 III. n. A field.
 --Comp.
मलपङ्किन् मलपङ्किन्, i. e. मल-पङ्क + इन्, adj. Covered with mud and dirt, Chr. 46, 20.
मलमल्लक मल-मल्ल + क, n. A piece of cloth worn over the privities, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 24.

मलय मलय, m.
 1. A mountainous range in the Dekhan, Lass. 38, 17; Vikr. d. 25.
 2. The country lying along this range, Malabar.
 3. A garden.
 4. The garden of Indra.
मलयज मलय-ज, m. and n. Sandalwood. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3322; Vikr. d. 51.

मलाका मलाका, i. e. मल + आक, f.
 1. A lewd woman.
 2. A female messenger.
 3. A female elephant.

मल्लक मल्ल + क,
 I. m.
 1. A tooth.
 2. A leaf to wrap up something, or a cup, Mṛcch. 126, 9 v. r.; cf. Wilson, Hind. Th. i. 2 ed. 134, n., and Stenzler, n.
 II. m., and f. लिका, An oil vessel.

ऽमालक -माल + क, at the end of comp. adj., f. लिका; e. g. अक्षर-, Consisting of a line of letters, Pañc. ii. d. 183. बद्ध-वन्दन-, adj. Having fastened garlands of salutation, Pañc. 207, 24 (but cf. वन्दन-माला, s. v. माल).

मलिन मलिन, i. e. मल + इन् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Dirty, Pañc. iii. d. 178; soiled, Hit. ii. d. 39.
 2. Black, Śiś. 9, 18; obscure, ib. 23; obscured, Hit. i. d. 27, M.M.
 3. Sinful.
 4. Bad.
 II. n.
 1. Fault.
 2. Buttermilk.
 --Comp.
मलिनत्व मलिन + त्व, n. Blackness, Cāṇ. 76 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 412.

मलिम्लुच मलिम्लुच् + अ (from an anomal. frequent. of म्लुछ्), m.
 1. A thief.
 2. The intercalary lunar month.
 3. Fire.
 4. Wind.
 5. An imp.

मलीमस मलीमस (cf. मल), adj.
 1. Dirty, Hit. ii. d. 148; stained, Ragh. 2, 33.
 2. Wicked.
मल्लघटी मल्लघटी, f. A kind of dancing, Vikr. 62, 19.

मल्लि and मल्ली मल्ली̆, f. Arabian jasmine, Jasminum zambac, Lass. 67, 7 (ली).
 --Comp.

मल्लिक मल्लिक,
 I. m.
 1.
 A sort of goose with brown legs and bill, Utt. Rāmac. 20, 4 (rather मल्लिकाख्य) []
 2. A shuttle.
 3. The month Māgha.
 II. f. का (i. e. मल्लि + क).
 1. Arabian jasmine, Ṛt. 6, 6.
 2. A goblet.
 3. A river.
 4. See मल्लक.

मालिक मालिक, i. e. माला + इक,
 I. adj. Relating to a garland.
 II. m.
 1. A flower-gatherer, Pañc. v. d. 55 (cf. Pañc. 156, 20).
 2. A painter.
 3. A sort of bird.
 III. f. का.
 1. A garland of flowers, Pañc. 236, 16.
 2. A multitude, Hit. iii. d. 89.
 3. A necklace.
 4. A daughter.
 5. A palace.
 6. A spirituous liquor.
 7. Double jasmine.
 --Comp.

मालती मालती, f.
 1. A bud.
 2. A young woman.
 3. Moonlight.
 4. Night.
 5. A river.
 6. Great-flowered jasmine, Jasminum grandiflorum, Megh. 26; Ṛt. 2, 25.
मालव मालव, m. The province of Malva, Hit. 113, 19.
मालाकार माला कार, m., f. री, A flower-seller, a gardener, Pañc. i. d. 394; Lass. 24, 8.
मालित मालित, i. e. माला + इत, Surrounded, Lass. 4, 18.

मालिन् मालिन्, i. e. माला + इन्,
 I. m. A florist.
 II. f. नी.
 1. A female vendor of flowers.
 2. A name of Durgā.
 3. The Ganges of heaven.
 4. A plant, Hedysarum alhagi.
 5. A shrub, Echites caryophyllata.
 III. As latter part of compounds, very often adj., f. नी, Wearing a garland or chaplet of, cf. comp.
 --Comp.
मालिन्य मालिन्य, i. e. मलिन + य, n. Blackness, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1915 (मालिन्यं को दोषः, What an object of blame is the blackness! i. e. the blackness is no object of blame).
मालूर मालूर, m. A fruit-tree, Aegle marmelos, Lass. 86, 6 (Prākṛ.).

माल्य माल्य, i. e. माला + य,
 I. adj. Fit for a garland.
 II. n.
 1. A flower, Johns. Sel. 40, 38.
 2. A garland, Pañc. 199, 19.
 3. A chaplet, Man. 2, 177.
 --Comp.
माल्यगुणाय माल्यगुणाय, a denomin. derived from माल्य-गुण with य, Ātm. To become a garland, Bhartṛ. 2, 78.

माल्यवन्त् माल्य + वन्त्,
 I. m. The name of a mountainous range.
 II. f. वती, The name of a river.
मल- + वाहिन् मल- + वाहिन्, adj. bringing stain, Hit. i. d. 47, M.M.
मलमल्लक- + शेष मलमल्लक- + शेष, adj. one to whom is left nothing but a small piece of cloth to cover his privities. Daśak. in Chr. 184, 24.
